## What's new

**🔄 Sync between your devices.** Set a *Sync passphrase* (8+ characters) in the plugin settings and use the same one on your other devices. My list, the alert lists, Run away, Hidden, the Log and saved names then sync through the Friends in Voice server.
- Everything is encrypted on your computer with your passphrase. The server only stores an unreadable blob and never sees the passphrase, your Discord ID, names or the Log.
- Sync talks only to the Friends in Voice server, never to Discord. It runs when Discord starts, a minute after something changes, and every 15 minutes. BetterDiscord also has a **Sync now** button.
- Personal Guards keys stay on each device.

**🏷️ Saved names.** People Discord hasn't loaded are looked up once, and then their name and avatar are saved. After that they're shown from the saved copy with no new request. Right-click someone → **Refresh name** to get it again.

## Update

Use the update notification in Discord. If it fails, download `FriendsInVoice-v1.21.0.zip`, extract the whole archive and run `repair.bat` (macOS: `repair.command`, Linux: `bash repair.sh`).

BetterDiscord: replace the installed plugin with `FriendsInVoice.plugin.js` from this release and enable it.
